# Genuine GoPro HERO5 GPMF sample provenance

The file hero5.raw is an exact byte-identical Git blob from:
https://github.com/gopro/gpmf-parser/blob/main/samples/hero5.raw

Source Git blob SHA-1: 338d94bd94449b80ced5ad6e63c1647323ecb79e.
Source file size: 4,792 bytes.
Source repository: gopro/gpmf-parser (dual Apache-2.0 / MIT license).

The payload contains camera metadata KLV structures including ACCL,
GYRO, GPS5, ISOG and SHUT. It is *not a fish recording*.
Original GoPro MP4 samples were not redistributed.
